name: Cable Rear Delt Row
steps: Attach a rope to a chest-height pulley and stand facing the machine in an athletic stance.
Grip both rope ends palms down and step back until your arms are extended under tension.
Pull the rope ends toward your upper chest while driving your elbows wide and back.
Squeeze your upper back briefly, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your torso steady rather than leaning backward to complete the pull.
